source_notes: Density and low-temperature heat capacity reference typical Ovako42CrMo4 values; not a received SCM440 certificate.
k35, E190GPa and alpha17e-6 are analysis assumptions. All conductances, die/heater capacities and radiation emissivity are uncalibrated.
Relay with +/-1C hysteresis is a numerical sensitivity excitation, not the released PID, a safe power sequence or a safety-trip test.
300C is a project comparison ceiling, NOT a supplier-approved sheath rating. No PI tape insulation credit.
